versions.subject: Add portable gpg.exe detection
versions.detection:
selection:
    - OriginalFileName: 'gpg.exe'
    - Description: 'GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool'
filter_legit:
    Image: 'C:\Program Files (x86)\GnuPG\bin\gpg.exe'
condition: selection and not filter_legit
versions.spl: OriginalFileName="gpg.exe" OR Description="GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool" NOT Image="C:\\Program Files (x86)\\GnuPG\\bin\\gpg.exe"

versions.subject: feat: update gpg4win rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\gpg.exe'
        - '\gpg2.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'gpg.exe'
    - Description: 'GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool'
filter_main_legit_location:
    Image|contains:
        - ':\Program Files (x86)\GnuPG\bin\'
        - ':\Program Files (x86)\GNU\GnuPG\bin\'
        - ':\Program Files (x86)\Gpg4win\bin\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\gpg.exe", "*\\gpg2.exe") OR OriginalFileName="gpg.exe" OR Description="GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool" NOT (Image IN ("*:\\Program Files (x86)\\GnuPG\\bin\\*", "*:\\Program Files (x86)\\GNU\\GnuPG\\bin\\*", "*:\\Program Files (x86)\\Gpg4win\\bin\\*"))
